source_row.rationale: Refeeding syndrome is characterized by clinically important electrolyte shifts after calories are reintroduced, particularly hypophosphatemia and often hypokalemia and hypomagnesemia. These abnormalities can cause serious cardiac and neurologic complications.
source_row.source_detail: ASPEN consensus recommendations, Nutrition in Clinical Practice 2020; diagnostic/electrolyte framework for refeeding syndrome; accessed 2026-08-14.
source_row.source_name: ASPEN — Consensus Recommendations for Refeeding Syndrome
source_row.stem: A severely malnourished client begins nutritional support. Which laboratory pattern is most concerning for refeeding syndrome?
